newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Argentine-led group wins Venezuela Onado oil bid.
newsitem.headline: Argentine-led group wins Venezuela Onado oil bid.

text.p: A consortium of Argentina's Compania General de Combustibles and Canada's Carmanah Resources Ltd bid $90.23 million Friday for the contract to operate the Onado oil field in eastern Venezuela, state oil company Petroleos de Venezuela (PDVSA) said.

In a close bidding round between eight companies and consortiums, the Argentine-Canadian group narrowly beat out China National Petroleum Corp which bid $89.17 million and France's Total which offered $86.58 million.
China National had already won two auctions earlier in the week.
A total of 131 companies are competing for 20 contracts in Venezuela's third round of operating licenses and the winners are determined purely by the size of their cash bids.
Under the 20-year contract, the operator will produce hydrocarbons on behalf of PDVSA subsidiary Corpoven in exchange for a fee worked out on a sliding scale.
Onado was discovered in 1971. As a condition of the contract, the operator must invest at least $10 million within three years, although PDVSA expects investment to be higher.
